source_refs.note: Topic 12.8 as printed (PDF 274, printed 271): the three conservation laws and the For Your Information box on hadrons and non-hadrons. 'nucleon number (N)' is marked.

blocks.text: All nuclear process such as nuclear reactions and nuclear decays obey conservation laws such as:

items: conservation of energy, momentum and charge. It includes the nucleon number (N) and charge number (Z).

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: By the book's own Eq. 12.1, the nucleon (mass) number is A; N is the neutron number. The conserved quantities are the nucleon number A and the charge number Z.

blocks.text:
